title: Add Badge/Tag
content: Build badge and tag component library. Badge variants: default (gray), primary (blue), success (green), warning (yellow), danger (red). Size options: sm (text-xs px-2 py-0.5), md (text-sm px-2.5 py-1), lg (text-base px-3 py-1.5). Styles: filled solid background, outlined border only, soft/light background (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700). Add optional icon prefix or suffix. Dot indicator variant: small colored dot before text. Removable tags: X button with hover state, onClick handler. Pill shape (rounded-full) vs rounded rectangle. Use cases: status indicators, categories, counts (notification badges), tags/labels. Truncation for long text with tooltip. Interactive hover states for clickable badges.

variants.simple: Build badge components for status indicators and labels.
variants.detailed: Build badge and tag component library. Badge variants: default (gray), primary (blue), success (green), warning (yellow), danger (red). Size options: sm (text-xs px-2 py-0.5), md (text-sm px-2.5 py-1), lg (text-base px-3 py-1.5). Styles: filled solid background, outlined border only, soft/light background (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700). variants.advanced: Build badge and tag component library with variants, sizes, and interactive states. Base badge: inline-flex items-center font-medium. Size variants: sm (text-xs px-2 py-0.5), md (text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5), lg (text-sm px-3 py-1). Shape: rounded-md (default) or rounded-full (pill prop). Color variants with filled style: default (bg-gray-100 text-gray-700), primary (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700), success (bg-green-100 text-green-700), warning (bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800), danger (bg-red-100 text-red-700). Outlined style: border border-current bg-transparent, e.g., border-blue-600 text-blue-600. Solid style: bg-blue-600 text-white for high emphasis. Dot indicator variant: flex items-center gap-1.5, span w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-current before text. Icon support: icon prop renders before text with gap-1, size matches badge size. Removable tag: onRemove prop enables X button, button ml-1 -mr-1 rounded hover:bg-black/10, X icon h-3 w-3. Interactive/clickable: when onClick provided, add cursor-pointer hover state (hover:bg-opacity-80 or shadow). Count badge (notification): rounded-full min-w-[20px] h-5 flex items-center justify-center, for numbers like unread count. Truncation: max-w with truncate class, title attribute for full text on hover. Status badge: specific styling for status indicators (Active, Pending, Archived). Group of badges: flex flex-wrap gap-2 for tag lists. Animation: subtle scale on add/remove for tag lists. ACCESSIBILITY: if interactive, use button element; if status, consider aria-label describing status; if removable, X button needs aria-label "Remove [tag name]". Component API: variant (color), size, pill (boolean), icon, onRemove, onClick, children.
